Loss report: gitlab -> gitea
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.pipeline_done (the source runs on the events pipeline, parent_pipeline and its file has no trigger form for them; Gitea has no event for them)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.resource (the source runs on the events external, chat and its file has no trigger form for them; Gitea has no event for them)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/5 trigger.api (event repository_dispatch is not supported by Gitea; the trigger is dropped)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/4 trigger.schedule: add on: schedule: - cron: <the cron of your GitLab pipeline schedule> to the workflow: GitLab keeps the schedule in the project settings, so the workflow has no schedule event and the job starts by workflow_dispatch (the schedule names no cron expression)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci job.if: !github.event.deleted on every job (GitHub Actions runs a push workflow when a branch is deleted and the source starts no run for that; each job condition ends with the guard)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.if: approximate expression translation (GitHub compares strings case-insensitively)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs, and GHA does not clone)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/script step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it, and a runner such as act runs a step with no shell under sh; the script re-executes under bash when the image has bash, else under sh -e)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/mrjob job.if: approximate expression translation (GitHub compares strings case-insensitively)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/mrjob job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/mrjob step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs, and GHA does not clone)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/mrjob/step/script step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it, and a runner such as act runs a step with no shell under sh; the script re-executes under bash when the image has bash, else under sh -e)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/1 trigger.pull_request: pull_request: types: [opened, synchronize] (GitLab runs a merge request pipeline in the fork project, but a GHA pull_request run from a fork is a run of the base repository; the jobs that admit the pull request also run for fork pull requests)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/synth/checkout step.action (resolves against DEFAULT_ACTIONS_URL; default github)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/mrjob/synth/checkout step.action (resolves against DEFAULT_ACTIONS_URL; default github)
